# Warm-up: confirm the recursive baseline
def factorial_named(n):
    return 1 if n == 0 else n * factorial_named(n - 1)   # named self-call

print([factorial_named(n) for n in range(8)])
# [1, 1, 2, 6, 24, 120, 720, 5040]
